title: Kestrel and the Drop
author: Freya Joubert
blurb: Elodie Oyelaran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
